prompt:
The newsletter section in sections/newsletter-signup-count.liquid already renders an optional heading and a submit button. Its schema has a `subscriber_count` setting, but the markup does not use it yet. Add a subscriber count line. Keep the existing markup and the {% schema %} block exactly as they are. Inputs (all under section.settings; there are no top-level inputs): - section.settings.heading: string or null. The existing behaviour stays: strip it, and output the h2 only when the stripped value is non-empty. - section.settings.button_label: string or null. The existing behaviour stays: null or empty falls back to "Subscribe", and the value is HTML-escaped. - section.settings.subscriber_count: integer or null. New behaviour: - When subscriber_count is exactly 1, output

Join 1 subscriber

(singular). - When subscriber_count is greater than 1, output

Join N subscribers

, where N is the plain integer (for example "Join 1200 subscribers"). - When subscriber_count is null, 0 or negative, output no paragraph at all. - The paragraph goes directly after the heading (or directly after the opening div when there is no heading) and directly before the button. The section emits no whitespace between tags. The full output is
[h2][p]
, with nothing between elements. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/newsletter-signup-count.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
